Class DiagnosticAssert

java.lang.Object
org.assertj.core.api.AbstractAssert<DiagnosticAssert, List<Diagnostic<? extends JavaFileObject>>>
be.imgn.gaia.processing.testing.DiagnosticAssert
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.assertj.core.api.Assert<DiagnosticAssert, List<Diagnostic<? extends JavaFileObject>>>, org.assertj.core.api.Descriptable<DiagnosticAssert>, org.assertj.core.api.ExtensionPoints<DiagnosticAssert, List<Diagnostic<? extends JavaFileObject>>>
public final class DiagnosticAssert extends org.assertj.core.api.AbstractAssert<DiagnosticAssert, List<Diagnostic<? extends JavaFileObject>>>
AssertJ assertions on the diagnostics of a Compilation that matched an earlier assertion, such as CompilationAssert.hadErrorContaining(String). 
assertThat(compilation).hadErrorContaining("incompatible types").inFile("example/Foo.java").onLine(4);

Each method keeps the diagnostics that satisfy its condition, and fails if none does, so a chain finds the diagnostic it describes even when several share the same message.
